limitations: Candidate c17: public c16 7769d8f6 + the fixes for the public test suite and the image budget, nothing else. The core image budget is 1200 MiB (Nous decision 2026-11-10; Node 26 measured core linux/arm64 at 1158.1 MiB in Container matrix 42858766035). Nine test files that were stale in SpaceApp's source carry the Space fix bcbe773ee7: browser-routes-wiring, cli-browser-accounts, cli-routes-wiring, nous-pane-notices, nous-tokens, checkbox-switch-inventory, nous-goals and space-pool-route3 as test fixes, and safe-child-process through apps/api/src/server-ops-routes.ts, which now spawns through safe-child-process.ts. The server-ops routes are registered only when SPACE_PUBLIC_DISTRIBUTION is not true (cli-routes-wiring.ts), and every launcher install sets it to true, so no code path of an installed SpaceApp changed. Three tests that need private scripts or the operator's mail domain left the public tree through scripts/public-test-exclusions.json (nous-account-hold, cli-maintenance-orphans-postgres, key-pools). The public tree skips one web test, responsive-shell "keeps a persisted selected room active when it is beyond the default room page" (Nous approved it on 2026-11-10 under the operator's May approve Warm changes allowance; nothing else in the Warm tests, thresholds or App.tsx changed): after a reload the app opens the first room instead of the stored one, a failure older than 1.2.0 (Cody's c15-warm.md: it fails the same at 2aa0ad6705^, before the seven App.tsx commits Nous approved, at 0747cd544e of 2026-10-24 and at 520b8ba95c). Its fix goes through Space and removes the skip. Gate 2 on Windows (Cody, 2026-11-10 17:56-18:10Z, supplementary windows/first-agent-zen-azure): the c15 first-agent case passed on Zen (opencode/big-pickle, exit 0, no refusal) on a native Azure Windows 11 Pro VM, with the c15 launcher and images (built from 64c3e71), not rebuilt for c17; the lab VM219 cannot run WSL2, so the required windows/first-agent check stays c14's under the Zen exception. macOS (VM221) has not re-run on Zen. After the first full CI run: files-upload-http waits for the staged-file cleanup the upload route runs after its reply (CI 42879837540), and .gitleaksignore lists the 8 reviewed findings of 1a2d8e72, Vault key handles (vault_key:<id>), opaque ids and not credentials (Security 42879854034). CI on 69bbf86a: attempt 1 failed only the real-Chrome frame-stream poll of browser-account-profile-chrome (it passed on 2d18377e), attempt 2 (run 42885561245) failed nous.test.ts because a random pane id ended in "-" and the trailing \b of paneIdIn cut it off; Nous now reads a pane or CLI session id ending in "-" whole, and a test pins it. CI and Security on 25f3ba36 (42895647306, 42895663412): the event-loop report lost a block that ended at its tick (reset() ran before the delay histogram recorded it), so it now reads in setImmediate; the needs-you code test looked for "481", which was inside a random notification id, and now looks for the whole code. The mail sync test read the two newest events by position, and the expired-history note and the gap's mail can share a millisecond (a tie orders by random id, Security 42895663412): it now finds each by type. CI 42895647306 attempt 2 on 25f3ba36: the Space Control video capture test read the capture request right after a fake 6 s, but the capture reaches the browser after real file I/O; it now waits for the request. CI 42905475477 on c7ec1dfa: the event-loop test still failed; reset() also forgets the delay histogram's last tick, so a block that straddles a report is lost even with the setImmediate read. The test blocks 100 ms after a report, inside an interval, and the code names the limit (the next block profiles). Every check and supplementary proof stays c15's (c14's own run, or what c14 carried from c13) with its createdAt.

Candidate c16: public 1a2d8e72 (the c15 tree 64c3e71 squashed for publication, candidateDigest ca071c95) + four CI fixes and nothing else: .github/workflows/release.yml installs the packages before the readiness checks, packages/run-spaceapp/tests/runtime.test.mjs reads compose.yml with LF line endings on Windows checkouts, packages/run-spaceapp/package.json runs its tests with a bare node --test (Node 20 on Windows expands no tests/*.test.mjs glob), and PUBLIC_EXPORT_MANIFEST.json records the size and SHA-256 of the package-lock.json this tree carries. No launcher, image or app code changed, so every check and supplementary proof stays c15's (c14's own run, or what c14 carried from c13) with its createdAt.
